# ZebraByte

> ZebraByte combines cyber security, privacy, compliance, accessibility and secure managed infrastructure with an open-source compliance platform derived from Probo.

ZebraByte focuses on practical security and continuous compliance: security assessment, website and email protection, incident response, GDPR/privacy, NIS2, ISO 27001 readiness, secure managed hosting and digital accessibility. The website preserves and extends the Probo experience, including its documentation, Hub, Stories, compliance portal architecture, developer APIs and upstream endpoint agent.

## LLM resources

- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-docs.txt): Links to documentation pages in clean Markdown.
- [Complete documentation corpus](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-full.txt): Documentation corpus in one text file.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/sitemap-index.xml): Discover public pages.

For a token-efficient Markdown version of a supported page, request its canonical URL with the `Accept: text/markdown` header.

## ZebraByte cyber security

- [Cyber Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/cyber-security): Main security program and operating model.
- [Security Assessment](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/security-assessment): Review of exposed services, website, domain, email and technical controls with prioritized remediation.
- [Website Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/website-security): WAF, DDoS protection, malware monitoring, hardening and recovery.
- [Email Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/email-security): SPF, DKIM, DMARC, anti-spoofing, phishing/BEC controls and account hardening.
- [Incident Response](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/incident-response): Triage, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.
- [Secure Managed Hosting](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/secure-hosting): Security-first managed infrastructure.

## ZebraByte compliance and trust

- [GDPR & Privacy](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/gdpr): Privacy governance and technical measures.
- [NIS2 Readiness](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/nis2): Governance, risk, controls, resilience and incident readiness.
- [ISO/IEC 27001 Readiness](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/iso-27001): ISMS implementation and audit readiness.
- [Compliance Portal](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/compliance-portal): Trust, NDA, documents, approvals and evidence sharing.
- [Digital Accessibility](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/accessibility): WCAG assessment and remediation.
- [Trust Center](https://trust.zebrabyte.ro): ZebraByte security and compliance information.

## Upstream attribution

The compliance website/platform experience is derived from the MIT-licensed Probo project. Probo visuals, logos, case-study media, authors, technical names, API paths, agent binary names and historical content are intentionally preserved where useful. Upstream organizations and people must not be interpreted as ZebraByte customers or employees unless separately documented as such.
